name: Brace
description: +2 OCV with Ranged attacks; −2 DCV

name: Set
description: +1 OCV with Ranged after spending a full Phase aiming

name: Haymaker
description: Add +4 DCs to next attack; −5 DCV until your next Phase

name: Move By
description: Attack while moving past target; −2 OCV, −2 DCV

name: Move Through
description: Ram target at speed; −v/5 OCV (typical −3), −3 DCV

name: Grab
description: Seize an opponent; −1 OCV, −2 DCV

name: Grab By
description: Grab while moving through target; −3 OCV, −4 DCV

name: Sweep
description: Attack multiple targets; −2 OCV per additional target

name: Multiple Attack
description: Multiple attacks in one Phase; −2 OCV cumulative per attack after the first

name: Disarm
description: Knock a weapon from opponent's hand; −2 OCV, no damage

name: Shove
description: Push opponent without full damage; −1 OCV, −1 DCV

name: Range: Short (−2)
description: Target is at short range (≈8–16m); −2 OCV

name: Range: Medium (−4)
description: Target is at medium range (≈17–32m); −4 OCV

name: Range: Long (−6)
description: Target is at long range (≈33–64m); −6 OCV

name: Range: Extreme (−8)
description: Target is at extreme range (≈65–125m); −8 OCV

name: Called Shot
description: Aim for a specific Hit Location; −4 OCV

name: Limited Visibility
description: Partial obscurement (smoke, dim light, rain); −2 OCV

name: No Visibility
description: Attacking blind or in total darkness; −4 OCV (or per GM ruling)

name: Target Is Prone (Melee)
description: Melee attack against a prone opponent; +2 OCV

name: Target Is Prone (Ranged)
description: Ranged attack against a prone opponent; −2 OCV (smaller target)

name: Flanking / Rear Attack
description: Attacking from behind or flanking; +2 OCV

name: Autofire (1 target)
description: Autofire against one target; +4 OCV.

name: Bouncing Attack (+1)
description: Bouncing attack bonus at low surprise level; GM may allow +1 to +3 OCV.

name: Bouncing Attack (+2)
description: Bouncing attack bonus at medium surprise level; GM may allow +1 to +3 OCV.

name: Bouncing Attack (+3)
description: Bouncing attack bonus at high surprise level; GM may allow +1 to +3 OCV.

name: Braced (+1 OCV)
description: Braced ranged attack grants +1 OCV. If using strict rule 'DCV drops to 0', apply that manually.

name: Move and Attack
description: If the attacker moved and attacks (except Move Through/Move By), apply -1 OCV.

name: Surprise Maneuver (+1)
description: Surprise maneuver bonus; GM sets level from +0 to +3 OCV.

name: Surprise Maneuver (+2)
description: Surprise maneuver bonus; GM sets level from +0 to +3 OCV.

name: Surprise Maneuver (+3)
description: Surprise maneuver bonus; GM sets level from +0 to +3 OCV.
